semanticRules.PORTED: Allowed only with exact implemented target and current executable proof; documentation or upstream presence never suffices.
semanticRules.PORT_REQUIRED: Behavior is approved in principle but not yet proven implemented in Solo.
semanticRules.TEST_ONLY: Source path is test evidence to translate; it is not product implementation.
semanticRules.REJECTED: Behavior or exact source transport shape must not enter Solo.
semanticRules.BOOKKEEPING_ONLY: Upstream release metadata is immutable source-history evidence only and can never mean Solo adopted or ported it.

authorityPolicy.trackingSourceRecording: The exact upstream chain may be recorded/fast-forwarded on public fork v5 when SHA/ancestry proof passes, even when pure-upstream CI is red.
authorityPolicy.productAdoption: No behavior is adopted until PORT_REQUIRED targets are implemented, focused/negative contracts pass on maintained GitHub mainline, boundaries pass, and release evidence is green.
authorityPolicy.releaseBookkeeping: All upstream .changeset, changelog, package-version, prerelease-state, and public-boundary-snapshot touches are BOOKKEEPING_ONLY; none is PORTED or adopted.

upstreamExactShaCiEvidence.requiredRepair: Repair/upgrade the maintained dependency and toolchain graph on GitHub main, rerun audit plus build/package/API/boundary/test gates, then validate each approved behavior; do not rewrite pure upstream commits and do not use the red audit as permission to block recording exact upstream source on v5.
